title: John Chrysostom on Philemon 1:1
body: “These things are said to a master in behalf of a servant. Immediately at the outset, he has pulled down his spirit, and not suffered him to be ashamed, he has quenched his anger; calling himself a prisoner, he strikes him with compunction, and makes him collect himself, and makes it appear that present things are nothing.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon, Homily 1
bodyEs: “Estas cosas se dicen a un amo en favor de un siervo. Enseguida, desde el principio, le ha bajado el espíritu, y no ha permitido que se avergüence; le ha apagado la ira; llamándose preso, lo hiere de compunción, y lo hace recogerse, y hace parecer que las cosas presentes no son nada.”

title: John Chrysostom on Philemon 1:4
body: “He does not immediately at the commencement ask the favor, but having first admired the man, and having praised him for his good actions, and having shown no small proof of his love, that he always made mention of him in his prayers, and having said that many are refreshed by him, and that he is obedient and complying in all things; then he puts it last of all, by this particularly putting him to the blush. For if others obtain the things which they ask, much more Paul.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon, Homily 2
bodyEs: “No pide el favor enseguida al comienzo, sino que, habiendo admirado primero al hombre, y habiéndolo alabado por sus buenas acciones, y habiendo mostrado una prueba no pequeña de su amor, que siempre lo mencionaba en sus oraciones, y habiendo dicho que muchos son recreados por él, y que es obediente y complaciente en todas las cosas, entonces lo pone al final de todo, y con esto en particular lo hace sonrojarse. Porque si otros obtienen las cosas que piden, mucho más Pablo.”

title: John Chrysostom on Philemon 1:17
body: “No procedure is so apt to gain a hearing, as not to ask for everything at once. For see after how many praises, after how much preparation he hath introduced this great matter.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon, Homily 3
bodyEs: “Ningún procedimiento es tan apto para ganar audiencia como no pedirlo todo de una vez. Porque mira después de cuántas alabanzas, después de cuánta preparación, ha introducido este gran asunto.”
